newsitem.title: CHINA: China budgeted state sector loses $6.38 bln in '96.
newsitem.headline: China budgeted state sector loses $6.38 bln in '96.

text.p: Losses by Chinese state-owned enterprises included in the national budget soared to 52.99 billion yuan ($6.38 billion) in 1996, up 38.8 percent compared with the previous year, the Xinhua news agency said on Friday.

About 75 percent of China's more than 100,000 state firms lost money last year, with total losses in the government sector rocketing 45 percent to 69 billion yuan between January and October, official figures show.
Xinhua said the rise in losses from firms included in the state budget was steepest in the capital Beijing, where state firms lost 836 million yuan in 1996, up 192 percent year-on-year.
In Shanghai, losses reached 1.17 billion yuan, an increase of 49.6 percent compared with 1995, it said.
